turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have about twenty minutes, Hale, and I'd like to know why my son found out he had a zero from his phone in the middle of class. Who decided that, and why didn't anyone call me first?
So the defense is that he just types really fast?
I haven't offered a defense, Hale. I asked who decided on the zero and why nobody called me first. "Types really fast" means what, exactly?
182 words in six minutes. Wow. Maybe he should be a court stenographer.
"182 words in six minutes." Where does that number come from, Hale? I'm still waiting for an answer on who decided on the zero, and I'm not here for jokes.

I'm not here as counsel, Hale, I'm here as Owen's mother, and I haven't offered a theory. You have, apparently, and I'd like to see what it rests on. Who decided on the zero, and what document is it based on?
